gitlab_host.description: IP address of the target host where GitLab will be deployed. Must be accessible from the OIM server.

gitlab_project_name.description: Name of the GitLab project that Omnia creates or manages. This project is created automatically if it does not exist. Default: omnia-catalog.

gitlab_project_visibility.description: Visibility level for the GitLab project. private: access must be granted explicitly for each user. internal: can be cloned by any logged-in user. public: can be cloned without any authentication. Default: private.

gitlab_default_branch.description: The default branch used for repository and API operations. This branch is used as the default for all operations. Default: main.

gitlab_https_port.description: HTTPS port exposed via GitLab NGINX. Must be between 1-65535 and must not conflict with other services. Default: 443.

gitlab_ssh_port.description: SSH port for git+ssh operations. Accepted values: valid port number (1-65535). Default: 22

gitlab_min_storage_gb.description: Free disk space in GB validated before install. GitLab requires at least 20GB of free disk space. Default: 20.

gitlab_min_memory_gb.description: Minimum RAM in GB required before install. Accepted values: integer >= 1. Default: 4

gitlab_min_cpu_cores.description: Minimum CPU core count validated before install. More cores may be needed for production workloads. Default: 2.

gitlab_puma_workers.description: Number of Puma web worker processes. Scale with CPU cores (recommended: 1-2 workers per CPU core). Default: 2.

gitlab_sidekiq_concurrency.description: Sidekiq background job concurrency. Adjust based on available memory and workload. Default: 10.

oim_api_verify_ssl.description: Verify SSL certificate when connecting to OIM API. Set to false for self-signed certs. Accepted values: true or false. Default: true

gitlab_cert_dir.description: Directory on target host where cert artifacts are generated/stored. Accepted values: absolute path string. Default: /root/gitlab-certs

gitlab_ssl_dir.description: Final SSL directory consumed by GitLab Omnibus. Accepted values: absolute path string. Default: /etc/gitlab/ssl

gitlab_repo_script_url.description: URL for the GitLab package repository setup script. Override only when pinning to gitlab-ee or a specific version.
